required: Use the exact source SHA256 and 54 raw tiles
Generate terrain geometry directly from numeric elevation samples
Keep source elevation delta at zero
Preserve immutable real line hydrology and node connectivity
forbidden: Any compression of DEM or native tiles
Any height image texture as terrain input
Any interpolation or synthetic gap fill
Any old Guilin DEM, preview, screenshot page, archive, duplicate cache or rollback asset
Any artificial lake or reservoir surface
review_html_rule: Public HTML must be a real interactive WebGL2 view generated from numeric samples. Screenshots may exist only transiently for QA and must be deleted.
